$Comment: Rusted Rivet Guard of the Expanse surface (world spawn, notes/world-spawns.md): the Rivet Guard's template (shield guard, bash, mace, rally) with the Pumpworks' rusted body. Weathered and weaker than the Heartworks guard (220 HP): 100 HP, a little slower. Damage stays the template's (its damage variables are being renamed for the club, so they are not overridden here). Surface drop list: scrap, bolts, studs or bronze, no held-item drops (those stay Heartworks rewards). Rally reaches both robot groups.
